newsitem.title: USA: Russia credit ratings steal spotlight, debt soars.
newsitem.headline: Russia credit ratings steal spotlight, debt soars.

text.p: Russian debt stole the spotlight Monday, gaining over three points as high speculative-grade ratings placed Russia among the best of emerging debtor nations, traders said.
"The focus today was Russian debt....It gained over three points on the ratings news," one trader said. "Volume was very heavy."
Shortly after the news, Russian Vnesh US$ traded as high as four points in heavy volume to end the New York trading session up 3-5/8 at 78 bid, traders said.
Among other Brady bonds, trading remained light as Russia's highly anticpated debt ratings and upcoming Eurobond isssue remained the focus of Monday's session, trader said.
"We saw some light volume in other Brady bonds, and prices ended mixed on the day, but Russian debt was the key gainer," said another trader.
Argentine FRBs and Par bonds fell 3/8 to 84-3/4 bid and 60-1/2 bid, respectively, while Brazilian Cs were off 1/8 at 72 bid.
In other issues, Venezuela Par bonds were bid up 1/8 at 72-3/8.
